description: $2,000 from a Duke Energy employee resource group for Carolinas seniors entering engineering, computer science, sciences, or business.
eligibility_text: Graduating senior at a North or South Carolina high school; 3.5 minimum unweighted GPA; full-time at a four-year college in NC or SC; enrolling in engineering, computer science, the sciences, accounting, finance or business administration; U.S. citizen; finalists interview.
